title: Graph comparison in the identity-proper open model
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and a quasi-compact open immersion j:X to Y of schemes, the specified canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison for Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j equals the whiskering of rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso by the derived open extension, followed by its right unitor. No Noetherian hypothesis or auxiliary compactification is required.

source.place: Tag 0F4L, graph description of extension by zero; SGA 4 XVII 6.2.11; identity-proper specialization of graph normalization.

proof.text: Postcompose the sheaf graph map with the monic compactification inclusion into direct image. Graph normalization, the right identity law for direct image, and naturality identify the graph map with the inverse direct-image identity comparison.

Evaluate on a homotopy representative using normalizationHomotopyComponent. Commute the exact factorizations through the right-derived identity comparison. Apply its unit factorization, then the degreewise sheaf identity, and cancel the remaining exact factors. Localization and cancellation of the graph isomorphism give the stated inverse comparison. Identity and empty opens satisfy the same calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphOpenModelComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] :
    canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A j (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategory
        (rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso A Y) ≪≫ Functor.rightUnitor _
